pages.text: This bone meal allows to grow dyed grasses, sea grasses and ferns just like its vanilla counterpart.$(br2)Additionally, by using it on other plants from the mod, they will grow into their next stage with a new color.$(br)
$(br)To add color to bone meal, you need to create a $(l:utility/dyeing_station)Dyeing Station$() and use the ingredients according to $(l:colors_ingredients_list_category)Colors and Ingredients$().
